scope: Source and mocked native-field snapshot normalization only; no actual native execution, production, save/load or rendered UI acceptance.

checks.name: Native point sample yields exact ratio and rate-based simulation estimate, independent of active.started
Paused, power and capacity samples retain real work but never publish a countdown
Fresh no-subject confirmation clears completed-unit progress despite lingering app active bookkeeping
Missing or inconsistent native state remains unavailable and never claims an authoritative total
Replacement subject and loaded native start identity are sampled freshly, without cached carryover
External/native future orders keep queue total unknown; custom known queue requires matching current design
Finished work and zero-rate samples do not invent a completion countdown
Factory snapshot includes fresh observer state and explicit queue completeness
Native observer reads existing counters and is Towers-gated without calling mutating production functions
